title: BEFORE, DURING AND AFTER
content: Thank you for supporting my work! To ensure a smooth, secure, and professional collaboration, please carefully read the following Terms of Service before requesting a commission. By proceeding, you automatically agree to these terms.

title: PAYMENT CONDITIONS AND METHODS
content:
- All payments must be processed exclusively via **PayPal Invoices** to ensure legal tracking and mutual protection against chargebacks.
- The client provides their email and the artist send the facture to that email provided.
- Direct transfers (e.g., via PayPal.me or links found on my social media) are **STRICTLY NOT ACCEPTED** as valid commission payments.
- If you don't have a PayPal account, you can use other payment method (info before rules, e.g. Nequi, Global66).
- An **initial payment of 50%** is required before starting any structural work.
- The **remaining 50%** must be settled after approval of the watermarked final work.
- **FINAL DELIVERY RETENTION:** High-resolution files are strictly retained until the payment is verified as **"Completed"** in my account. Screenshots of "Pending" transfers can be accepted as valid. (100% upfront is also welcome).

title: COMMISSIONS AND THIRD-PARTY FEES
content:
- The prices listed in the commission table represent the NET amount the artist must receive.
- The client is responsible for covering additional processing fees imposed by PayPal.
- The final amount will be automatically calculated on the official Invoice to ensure the total payment covers both the service and the transaction fees.

title: COMMERCIAL USE SURCHARGES
content:
- Base prices include Personal Use only (icons, personal banners, printing for private use).
- Monetizing the work (merchandising, commercial streaming, VTuber assets, promotions) requires a **Commercial License** (read tier specifications).
- It is strictly **forbidden** to use my work to **train AI models** or **sell as NFTs**.

title: YCH AND POSE COMPLEXITY
content:
- Base prices may increase depending on the complexity of the character design (wings, detailed armor, complex patterns).
- High-difficulty poses, extreme perspectives (severe foreshortening), or complex physical interactions between multiple characters will also increase the value.
- This adjustment will be discussed transparently during the quote phase prior to the initial invoice.

title: REFERENCES AND PROVIDED MATERIAL
content:
- By providing a sketch, idea, or specific pose, the client legally warrants they have the rights to use it.
- The artist is not liable for copyright claims arising from client-provided material. It is the client's absolute responsibility to verify their sources.
- Real photographic references, 3D models, or YCH catalog designs are highly recommended.
- AI-generated references are accepted for specific concepts, but interpreting them may increases the complexity value of the final piece.

title: SKETCH PROCESS AND REVISIONS
content:
- The client will receive constant updates during the sketching phase.
- Up to **3 major structural corrections** (pose, anatomy, main clothing) are allowed free of charge at this stage.
- Once the sketch is approved and lineart or base color begins, the structure is officially locked.

title: LATE CHANGES AND PENALTIES
content:
- Requesting structural, anatomical, or pose changes during the coloring or detailing phase will incur an additional fee.
- This fee ranges between **20% and 50%** of the total price, depending on the hours required to undo and redo the processed work.
- Minor adjustments (e.g., base color tones) can be discussed without extra charge at the artist's discretion.

title: WAIT TIMES AND COMMUNICATION
content:
- Standard response time: **3-7 business days**.
- Completion time: **1 to 4 weeks** depending on complexity and the current queue.
- Weekends are strictly reserved for rest; no progress updates or quick replies will be provided on these days.
- In the event of an unexpected delay, the client will be notified immediately.
- I appreciate your patience as I meticulously manage my schedule to deliver the highest quality artwork possible.

title: SALE - SIGNATURE - REDISTRIBUTION
content:
- The client is granted full personal use rights upon complete payment.
- Reselling the artwork for profit is **100% PROHIBITED** without a commercial license.
- Proper credit to the artist is mandatory when publishing the commission on any platform.

title: SOCIAL MEDIA AND PUBLIC DISPLAY
content:
- The artist reserves full rights to publish the commissioned work on their portfolios and social networks.
- The client has a **7-day period** post-delivery to request privacy. If no request is made, the artist will proceed to publish freely.

title: IMAGE EDITING - IMAGE FILE
content:
- The client has a **7-day period** post-delivery to request minor post-edits.
- Editing the image yourself is not permitted without prior authorization. Post-edit requests made after 7 days are subject to availability and extra charges.

title: ABOUT THE SOURCE FILE (.PSD)
content:
- The original **.psd** project file is not provided by default.
- Purchasing the source file incurs a strict extra charge. If purchased, it is delivered with locked layers. Extra fees apply to unlock specific layers.
- The artist's signature layer is permanent.

title: SIGNATURE VIOLATION
content:
- The artist's signature is mandatory and will never be removed from the final artwork.
- Removing, cropping, or altering the signature automatically voids any right to refunds, future support, or modifications.

title: FINAL DELIVERY
content:
- Final files are delivered via a private **Google Drive** link.
- This link remains active for exactly **30 days**. The client is responsible for downloading and backing up their files within this period (a permanent link can be provided at no cost if explicitly requested at the start).
- The artist is not responsible for the integrity of files requested to be sent through third-party platforms (Telegram, Email, etc.).

title: CONTENT ORDER IN FOLDERS
content:
- To ensure the best balance between quality and performance, files are delivered in **PNG** (supports transparency) and optimized **JPG**.
- Requests for massive resolutions or specialized formats beyond standard web-use may incur an extra fee for processing time.
- Depending on the layer, note, color, or any extra content added or changed, it will be located in the subfolder with its respective code name.

title: FOLDER HIERARCHY
content:
📦 [Delivery Date] + [Username] + [Artist]
├── 📄 IMPORTANT.txt (T.O.S Document)
├── 📂 Optimized-NormalQuality
